0.heading: Overview
refs: Psa 87:1 , The nature and glory of the church
Psa 87:4 , The increase, honour, and comfort of the members thereof.
It is highly probable that this Psalm was written by one of the descendants of Korah on the return from the Babylonian captivity. It seems to have been written in praise of Jerusalem
and, typically, of the Christian church.
